decisions.reason: The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY recording the requirement to support both motors, solenoids, and fans under load; no additional update or removal is required.
The electrical load-capacity decision does not change the existing splash-control behavior or methods.
Power-system capacity under load does not alter the selected whisk head, material, size, or positioning criterion.
The source decision does not change whisk detachment or tool-free removal behavior.
The electrical load-capacity requirement does not change bowl capacity, form, or compactness constraints.
The candidate's smooth and frothy mixing criteria remain valid unchanged by the power-supply capacity decision.
Supporting the electrical load does not change bowl removal, clearance, or swapping behavior.
The power-capacity decision does not modify the established 3000 RPM maximum or variable-speed operating range.
Electrical load capacity has no necessary effect on bowl, spout, or whisk cleanability requirements.
The source decision does not alter the base stability or vibration-resistance requirement.
Requiring adequate power capacity does not necessarily change the off-the-shelf component strategy or custom spout strategy.
The electrical system must support the solenoids under load, but this does not change their existing valve mechanism, actuation behavior, or closed-state behavior.
